title: The Titan Beetle's Jaws Can Snap a Pencil in Half

scenes.text: This beetle's jaws can snap a pencil in half.
It's the titan beetle, a rainforest giant.
It grows up to 6.5 inches, or 16 centimeters, long.
Experts think that's about as big as a beetle can get.
Its jaws are strong enough to split a pencil in two.
A beetle that bites a pencil in half.
